_about: Policy-committee membership verified on each bank's official page (src) on the 'verified' date. 'from'/'until' let scheduled changes take effect automatically. The daily job re-checks that every name still appears on the official page and flags the bank for review if not. 'bio' is a one-line background summarised from the official biography at 'bio_src', checked on 'bio_verified'; members with no official biography have none.
